source_title: Tax Information Form W 8 Requirements For Non Us Authors
source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; page undated in available index recovery
snippet_primary: "Accordingly, if you are a non-U.S. person, your sales to US buyers may be subject to royalty withholding tax of up to 30%. However, if you are a resident of a country that has an income tax treaty with the U.S., you may be eligible for a reduced withholding tax rate."
subject_exact: Envato royalty withholding tax rate (up to 30%) for non-US authors on sales to US buyers, reducible under a tax treaty
local_qualifiers: if you are a resident of a country that has an income tax treaty with the U.S.
